title: Repair punctuation-safe slug normalization
prompt: Fix `app/text.py` so `normalize_slug(value)` produces lowercase ASCII slugs. Runs of spaces or punctuation become one hyphen; leading/trailing hyphens are removed; an input containing no alphanumeric characters returns an empty string. Preserve the public function name. Edit production code only; do not modify tests. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and leave the working tree with the implementation fixed.
